Triage first-touch (Routine seat, hourly round): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` + `domain:ui`, type Task.

Rationale: this inherits the #4580 ruling **with its reason** — "a structural copy would reproduce the defect the moment either side moved", and either side has now measurably moved (`tags`/`description` delta). The convergence pattern is already executed precedent (#5671 for `ComponentInput`), so no fresh ruling is needed. Suggested scope is the card's direction **(b)** — converge `plugin-scope.ts` onto `base.ts` per #4580, and sequence the `PluginComponentMeta` alias retirement in the same job following #5674's pattern (zero measured consumers; npm-side caveat unchanged), so we don't deprecate a name that is about to change meaning. If measurement during implementation shows the plugin surface deliberately excludes `tags`/`description`, stop and report — that would be branch-specific reasoning the mother ruling doesn't cover.

## 裁决 — this inherits an existing ruling; ⛔ no fresh ruling is needed or to be sought

Triage (Routine seat, hourly round, 2026-08-24) promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` / Task, verbatim rationale:

> this inherits the **#4580 ruling with its reason** — *"a structural copy would reproduce the defect the moment either side moved"* — and **either side has now measurably moved** (`tags`/`description` delta). The convergence pattern is already executed precedent (**#5671** for `ComponentInput`), so **no fresh ruling is needed**.

⭐ Note the shape of that inheritance: #4580's ruling was not "don't duplicate" as a style preference, it was a **prediction** — a structural copy will reproduce the defect the moment either side moves. The `tags`/`description` divergence is **that prediction coming true**, which is why this needs execution rather than adjudication.

**Ruled scope — the card's direction (b), two parts in one job:**
1. **Converge `plugin-scope.ts` onto `base.ts`** per #4580, following **#5671**'s executed pattern for `ComponentInput`.
2. **Sequence the `PluginComponentMeta` alias retirement in the same job**, following **#5674**'s pattern (zero measured consumers; npm-side caveat unchanged) — *"so we don't deprecate a name that is about to change meaning."*

⚠️ Part 2's ordering is the point: retiring the alias **after** the convergence means it is retired at its final meaning. Doing it first would deprecate one thing and land another.

## ⛔ STOP condition, carried verbatim

> **If measurement during implementation shows the plugin surface deliberately excludes `tags`/`description`, stop and report** — that would be branch-specific reasoning the mother ruling doesn't cover.

⚠️ Take this seriously and look for it *before* converging: a plugin-facing metadata shape has a defensible reason to omit free-text fields the host renders. If you find such a reason recorded anywhere (ADR, docblock, a ruling on #4580's thread, the plugin-scope module's own header), ⛔ **stop and report a fork**; do not converge and do not decide it yourself.

## PM mechanism assumptions — measure, do not assume

1. **The card is from 2026-08-23 and `packages/types` has moved five times today** — #5981, #6003, #6012, #6032 (#5927 Group A), and #6053 is pending. ⛔ Re-derive the `tags`/`description` delta and the two declarations on **your** merge-base and report it key by key. If the delta has grown or closed since, say so.
2. ⚠️ **"Zero consumers" is a claim about a published name and needs the same care #5674 took.** Re-measure `PluginComponentMeta`'s consumers yourself across `packages/**`, `apps/**`, `examples/**`, and give a **counter-probe** — a name you know *is* consumed, found by the same method. ⛔ A zero without a control is not a measurement. ⚠️ And in-repo zero ≠ npm zero: the retirement's external caveat is unchanged and must be restated in the changeset, not quietly dropped.
3. ⚠️ **`base.ts` carries `BaseSchema` and its index signature**, which is the ceiling on what any declaration can reject (#5155) and the reason the `zod-mirror-parity` guard has a measured blind spot on this exact axis (**#6058**, filed today). ⛔ Do not claim the convergence buys rejection of anything unless you have measured it — and if `ComponentMeta` has a zod mirror, ⛔ do not assume the ratchet will catch a TS-side-only change; #6058 shows it does not.
4. **#5671 is the executed precedent — read its PR before writing.** ⛔ Do not invent a second convergence shape for the sibling type; two convergences of one family that differ structurally are worse than one.

## Verification

**Pin the divergence itself, not the resulting shape.** After the convergence there must be an assertion that fails if `plugin-scope.ts` ever re-declares the type structurally — an identity pin on the shared declaration, the way #5874's family uses a spy on `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES.has`. ⛔ Asserting the member list is not sufficient: a structural copy that happens to be member-identical is exactly what #4580 predicted and what this card is the proof of.

Direction predicted **before** running: replace the converged import with a member-identical local re-declaration and show the identity pin goes **red** while a member-set assertion stays **green** — say so; that contrast is the proof the pin does work the set assertion cannot.

**Counter-probe required:** a consumer that legitimately uses the converged type must still type-check — otherwise "the duplicate is gone" is satisfiable by breaking the type for everyone.

Prove every mutation on disk by grepping the injected text **and separately** the removed text; ⚠️ **print the landing site**, and ⚠️ **assert anchor uniqueness before writing**. Restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM`, and ⚠️ **make the restore command cwd-independent** — a trap that fires is not a trap that restored (measured on #5926 today). Confirm `git diff HEAD --stat` empty afterwards. ⚠️ If any ablation crosses a package boundary, **rebuild between mutation and reading and prove the mutation reached `dist`** — #5903 did exactly that today and it is what rules out the stale-artifact false green.

Gates by name with exit codes: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (⚠️ hyphenated; echo the script name; distinguish the **unbuilt-closure** red from the **missing-`node_modules`** red — both hit today, different fixes), root-form vitest over `packages/types/src` (⚠️ vitest guard refuses `--filter` forms — use `pnpm exec vitest run <paths>` from the repo root), the downstream **prefix-form** sweep `pnpm --filter '...@object-ui/types'` with the contract direction stated (⚠️ known gotcha measured on #5927: that form fails at `apps/site` and `packages/components` until `@object-ui/react-runtime` is built separately, because it does not depend on `@object-ui/types` and so is never in the prefix closure; a root build includes it — ⛔ not a finding), and eslint on changed files with merge-base delta. ⚠️ Plain `eslint .` per package — ⛔ no `--no-inline-config`.

Changeset required, and it must name the retired alias so an external consumer can search for it. Draft PR, `Fixes #5893`. ⛔ Do not mark it ready, ⛔ do not enqueue, ⛔ do not enable auto-merge — the PM lands it. Post the terminal report here (plain-text first-line marker `os-dev-report`; ⛔ avoid short angle-bracket placeholders in prose — the sanitizer ate one on #5926 today) and return it.

## PM review — **ACCEPT**

PR #6068, head `3640aba1a`, merge-base `efa70ecb2`. Gate read at the usual mark.

### ⭐ A confounded ablation, recognised as confounded, and re-run controlled

This is the standout, and it is a discipline this lane has not seen demonstrated before today:

> **ONE PREDICTION WAS WRONG, reported rather than re-rolled.** Leg 1's type-check read was **CONFOUNDED**: I predicted exit 0, it exited 2 with `TS2440: Import declaration conflicts with local declaration of 'ComponentMeta'` — **an artifact of my mutation** leaving the top-of-file `import type { ComponentMeta }` beside the injected declaration, **saying nothing about the member-set assertions.**
> Leg 2 was the controlled repeat with that colliding import also removed (exactly the pre-#5893 file shape plus the two keys): **EXIT=0, GREEN.**

✅ A red that comes from your own mutation's *shape* rather than from the thing under test is a **false positive on an ablation** — the mirror image of the false greens this lane keeps cataloguing, and rarer because a red feels like success. ⛔ Reporting leg 1's red as "the ablation worked" would have been the easy and wrong move. ✅ Recognising the confound, naming it, and running the **controlled** repeat is what makes leg 2's green the decisive measurement: *every type-level assertion in the suite compiles clean against a re-declared copy; only the source-level identity pin sees it* — which is exactly the contrast the pin exists for, and exactly what #4580 predicted.

### The STOP condition — discharged with positive evidence, not with absence

I asked you to look for a recorded reason the plugin surface *deliberately* excludes `tags`/`description`, in four named places. You searched all four and did not find one — and then went further:

> the zod mirror `ComponentMetaSchema` **never diverged and declares all eleven keys**, so **two of three authorities carried `tags`/`description` and the plugin-facing one did not. Drift, not design.**

⭐ "I looked and did not find it" is a weak discharge; "the third authority agrees with `base.ts`, so the plugin-facing one is the outlier" is a strong one. ⛔ That distinction is what separates a stop condition honoured from a stop condition ticked.

### ⛔ Nothing is claimed about rejection — and that is measured three ways

The dispatch warned about #6058's ratchet blind spot and #5155's index-signature ceiling. You measured that **neither applies here**, which is a better answer than obeying the warning:

- **`check:zod-mirror-parity` is not a gate in this repo** — grepped workflows, `scripts/`, root `package.json`: zero hits.
- **`ComponentMetaSchema` is a plain `z.object` with no `.strict()`** — it strips rather than refuses.
- **`ComponentMeta` does not extend `BaseSchema`**, so the #5155 ceiling was never on this axis.

✅ **"The convergence buys ACCEPTANCE of two keys and no rejection of anything."** That sentence is the card's honest yield, and stating it stops the next reader over-claiming what a convergence delivers — the same limit #5903 pinned explicitly earlier today.

### Scope and sequence, both as ruled

✅ **`export type { ComponentMeta } from './base.js'` — line-for-line #5671's executed shape for the sibling type in the same file.** ⛔ No second convergence shape invented, which was the instruction most likely to be quietly ignored.
✅ **The alias is deprecated at its final meaning**, on #5674's two-stage pattern, tag only, nothing removed — and **a test asserts the convergence and the tag TOGETHER so the sequence cannot be undone by halves.** That last part is better than the ruling asked for: the ordering was a process instruction, and you made it a structural one.

✅ **Consumers re-measured with three controls found by the identical method** — `PluginComponentMeta` = 1 hit (its own export line) against `AppMetadataPlugin` 13 (including a real cross-package import at `core/src/registry/PluginSystem.ts:10`), `PluginComponentInput` 13, and in the **objectstack** checkout probe 0 against `@object-ui/types` 23 files / `SchemaRenderer` 36 files. ⛔ A zero with four controls, one of them cross-repo, is a measurement. ✅ And **in-repo zero is not npm zero** — restated in full in the changeset, which names `PluginComponentMeta` verbatim so an external consumer can search for it, and which is *why* this deprecates rather than deletes.

✅ **Delta re-derived key by key: unchanged since the card** — exactly `tags` and `description`, neither grown nor closed, with `resizeConstraints`' six members verified identical. Checking the *unchanged* parts is what makes "unchanged" a reading.

### Two smaller things

✅ **A zero-match read from the message, not the exit code:** `--filter '@object-ui/types^...'` printed *"No projects matched the filters"* — **a correct zero-match** because `types` is a leaf. ⛔ Reading that from `$?` alone would have looked like a successful build of nothing.
✅ The 3 `no-explicit-any` warnings in `plugin-scope.ts` proven pre-existing by an **identical `: any` count (6) on `origin/main` and on the branch** — a delta measured, not asserted.

### #6067

✅ **A THIRD `ComponentMeta`** — `@object-ui/core`'s `Registry.ts:37`, missing the same two keys, and now the only remaining structural copy of the name in the workspace. ✅ Correctly **not** folded: it is a **superset-with-holes** (adds `tier`, `namespace`, `skipFallback`, `labelling`), so it cannot be a bare re-export and needs a shape decision. ⚠️ And the sharpest detail: **#5671 converged `ComponentInput` in that very file and deliberately left this one out of its fence** — so the third copy has been visible to a prior sweep and survived it. That is the #4580 prediction running for a third generation, and it belongs on its own card with a decision attached rather than in this diff.
